title: Abstract Unit Equipment
description: Defines the properties of various types of equipment found on a rig, unit, and during rigless operations.

EquipmentNumber.title: Equipment Number
EquipmentNumber.description: A number assigned to the Equipment to differentiate it from other identical equipment on the rigsite.

EquipmentManufacturer.title: Equipment Make
EquipmentManufacturer.description: The Make or Manufacturer of the equipment/unit

EquipmentTypeID.title: Equipment Type ID
EquipmentTypeID.description: A description of the "type" of equipment being defined. For example, a mud pump may have the "type" Triplex, Duplex, Mixing, etc. or a derrick type may be conventional, portable mast, box, etc.

EquipmentOwnerID.title: Equipment Owner ID
EquipmentOwnerID.description: The owner of the equipment or unit

EquipmentTag.title: Equipment Tag
EquipmentTag.description: An identification tag for the equipment/unit. A serial number is a type of identification tag; however, some tags contain many pieces of information. This element only identifies the tag and does not describe the contents.

Comments.title: Comments
Comments.description: Free text remarks about the equipment/unit.
